evidence.title: TernaryCode recovery-model
evidence.locator: Workspace, ProjectSave, PaneSave, Settings; src/actions.rs action enum; searched src and crates for issue tracker, backlog, epic, specification, acceptance, coordinator, SSO, cron and webhook.
evidence.finding: Persistent app records are projects, worktrees, tabs, panes, settings, profiles and paired devices. Action and model inventories contain no task/issue/plan/spec store, dependency dispatch, product coordinator, recurring-work scheduler, organisation membership, RBAC or SSO. Browser delegate symbols are native UI plumbing, not agent delegation.

evidence.title: TernaryCode recovery-runtime
evidence.locator: Action enum; src/app.rs pane launch/restore; src/ade.rs profile failover and logs; src/ship.rs ship plan; src/worktree.rs setup/merge. Search src/crates for schedule, timeout, max_turns, token budget, cost, export and import.
evidence.finding: The application starts local pane processes. No remote execution backend, container/VM runtime, run scheduler, task budgets, artifact gallery, workspace import/export command or delivery-check gate is present. Account quota failover is separate from task budgeting; ship plans run commit, push and PR steps without a product-owned test/spec gate. Git and browser operations have their own timeouts.

evidence.title: TernaryCode recovery-browser
evidence.locator: supported lines 90-107; crates/tc-agent/src/mcp.rs answer_with lines 155-198; crates/tc-web/src/main.rs Linux helper
evidence.finding: Browser panes use macOS WebKit, Windows WebView2 when installed, or the Linux X11/WebKitGTK helper. MCP tool exposure depends on pane credentials and TC_BROWSER_AGENTS, not a macOS compile gate. The mcp.rs introductory macOS-only comment is stale.

evidence.title: TernaryCode recovery-worktree
evidence.finding: Worktree setup copies selected ignored files and can run a user setup command before starting the agent only if that command succeeds. The Changes panel has Merge into base, which types git merge --no-ff --no-edit in the parent project terminal; conflicts remain terminal work. This is local branch merging, not a PR merge or deployment.

evidence.title: TernaryCode recovery-handoff
evidence.locator: switch_pane_profile_and_resume lines 925-1060; src/profiles.rs profile_env and write_handoff_context
evidence.finding: Same-provider switching copies the session when possible and uses native resume; otherwise it writes a redacted task and terminal-tail summary for the next profile, including cross-provider switches.
